title: StaticEnchantedItemRenderer
description: Just a simple Minecraft mod to render really static enchanted item effects.
body:
# English
This is a mod that can statically render enchanted items' render effects.

It can prevent the system from becoming sluggish due to excessive enchantment effects.

# 简体中文
这是一个模组，能够静态地呈现附魔物品的渲染效果。

它能够防止系统因过多的魔法效果而变得运行缓慢，卡顿。
